offensiveAbilities.name: Mauler
offensiveAbilities.description: The bear gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has Grabbed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rush
offensiveAbilities.description: The cave bear Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. During the Stride, it gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The bear deals 2d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are Off-Guard.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vitriol
offensiveAbilities.description:
The hateful bear vomits a stream of caustic black sludge at a single foe it can detect within 15 feet. The bear and the target each gain a +1 circumstance bonus on all attack rolls made against each other until the bear chooses a different target for its Vitriol. The target must attempt a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save, with the following effects. The bear cannot use Vitriol again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target's mind is clouded by feelings of rage and hate, causing it to be Off-Guard against the bear's next attack. It can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait.

Failure As success, but the target is off-guard until the end of the bear's next turn. While off-guard, it is unable to use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is off-guard until the bear chooses a different target for its Vitriol.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
